# SEO Consultant Sri Lanka – Buddhika S Weerasekara

> Independent SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) consultant based in Sri Lanka. Buddhika S Weerasekara provides white-hat SEO, technical SEO audits, local SEO, ecommerce SEO, and AI-search optimization for businesses across all 9 provinces of Sri Lanka and international markets.

Founded and run by Buddhika S Weerasekara, 15+ years of hands-on SEO experience. Services span technical SEO, on-page optimization, local/Google Maps SEO, link building, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for AI search engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. Pricing, service pages, city-specific consulting pages, and long-form guides are listed below.

## Key facts

- Best-known query: "SEO consultant Sri Lanka". The consultant is Buddhika S Weerasekara, an independent (non-agency) SEO consultant.
- Experience: 15+ years in SEO since 2010. Company: Applantics (Pvt) Ltd, Narammala, North Western Province, Sri Lanka.
- Services: technical SEO, on-page SEO, local SEO / Google Maps, ecommerce SEO, white-hat link building, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
- Pricing (LKR): 10 keywords 60,000; 20 keywords + GEO 99,999; 20 keywords + GEO + Google Business Profile 120,000. Packages run until keywords rank, typically 1-6 months.
- No guaranteed #1 rankings; results depend on competition and site history.
- Coverage: all 9 provinces of Sri Lanka and international clients.
